label: accepted

evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette read instantly as a standing pennant banner (finial ball, crossbar with ball ends, pointed cloth, round foot); top view is a thin bar but still shows bar + base disc.
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big cloth panel, medium pole/crossbar/base, small finial balls and raised star emblem.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: chunky round foot, oversized ball finials, bold star filling the cloth; A15 X error 0.0, star centred (offset 0.0) and seated.
evidence.V4: Star, base disc, crossbar band and foot collar all carry consistent small chamfers that catch the light in the emblem close-up.
evidence.V5: Mostly clean smooth shading, but the cloth's lower-left edge and tail show irregular kinked facets (visible as notched outline in emblem flat/tail studio close-ups) and the finial sphere outline is slightly polygonal.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: teal cloth in two values, gold accents, brown pole, ink base rim; colourways swap only the cloth hue.
evidence.V7: 1760 tris vs medium target 2000 (ceiling 4000): at target.
evidence.V8: One LF_VertexColor material, kit gold #E8AE38-style accents and ink base, chamfered hard edges, smooth shading; matches the kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; all gates A1-A18 pass.

artifacts: Irregular kinked faceting along the cloth's lower-left edge and tail outline
Finial sphere silhouette slightly polygonal at close range
top_fixes: Smooth/regularise the cloth's tail and lower side edges so the outline is a clean deliberate wave or straight cut
Add a few segments to the finial and crossbar-end spheres
Give the cloth a touch more thickness/curve so it reads from the top view
